# System Documentation Index (for LLMs & Coding Agents)

> **Unopinionated Data, Opinionated Lenses, Visual by Default, Connected by Design.** Local-First Visual Knowledge OS & High-Signal Social Knowledge Network combining **6 Reference Systems**: **Obsidian** (`.md` + `.app/config.json` + `@app/sdk` + `Freeform`), **Nodus Research** (opinionated Core Presets, Native BYO-AI / Ollama RAG, PDF/citations), **XMind** (deterministic Canvas2D solvers & 4 Helicopter Views), **Notion** (knowledge-focused Derived Views & block comments — **Explicit Non-Goal: NOT an enterprise task/project board**), **Wikipedia** (`/explore` open index & dual-pane reader), and **LinkedIn × ResearchGate × GitHub** (`/:username`, `[[@user/vault/note]]`, Essential VCS: Snapshot/Visual Diff/Fork/KMR).

## Essential Constitution & Entrypoints
- [Repository Rules & Guidelines (AGENTS.md)](AGENTS.md): Stack, 13 target domains (`community` + `dashboard`), 11 Mandatory Architectural Rules (Rule 11 = Changelog Sync).
- [Documentation Portal](docs/README.md): Role-based reading paths and full directory map.
- [Navigation Summary](docs/SUMMARY.md): Compact topic tree across all folders.
- [Master Blueprint v2.0](docs/00-meta/00-0-master-blueprint.md): Authoritative product constitution (6 Reference DNA, 4 Helicopter Views [`Graph`, `Diagram`, `Table`, `Cards`], Workspace Modes [`Freeform`, `Atlas`, `Studio`, `Academy` + `Community Presets`], Single `.app/config.json`, 3-Scope Settings Escalation, Essential VCS & Granular Vault/Node `AS & WITH`, `@app/sdk`).
- [Canonical Glossary](docs/00-meta/glossary.md): Authoritative definitions for Vault, Folder/File-Node, Workspace Mode, Helicopter Views, Restructure & Reorganize, Presentation Lenses (`atlas`, `publication`, `course`, `template`), and Academy 3-Layer Competence Tree.
- [Quo Vadis v2.0](docs/00-meta/00-2-quovadis.md): 20-dimension readiness audit, 3-Stage Progressive Shipping Gate, `EPIC-01`–`15`, and Locked Architectural Decisions.
- [Step-by-Step Execution Playbook](docs/02-planning/README.md): Ordered agent execution queue (`STEP-01.1` through `STEP-05.4`) with prerequisites and verification gates.

# AGENT OPERATING DIRECTIVE
1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `tail -n 15 docs/_machine/changelog.jsonl`, and `docs/02-planning/README.md` before coding to pick the next `[NEXT]`/`[PLANNED]` step (`STEP-01.1`..`05.4`).
2. Enforce single central `.app/config.json` (no fragmented `preset.json`/`lms-policy.json`/`setting.json`; `.vk/` & `.obmap/` legacy fallback only), 4 Helicopter Views across modes, Vault+Node granular `AS & WITH`, Xendit/Midtrans first, `CC BY-SA 4.0`, Headless Controller (`<= 300` lines), and explicit non-goal against enterprise project boards.
3. Before ending ANY task touching code, SQL, config, or architecture docs, perform all 3 atomic changelog updates required by `AGENTS.md` Rule 11 (`docs/_machine/changelog.jsonl`, `docs/changelogs/YYYY-MM.md`, `docs/changelogs/README.md`).
